habitat: Individuals, pairs or flocks at inland pans, dams and vleis, especially sewage ponds, and at coastal lagoons and estuaries. It wades in the shallows with the legs well immersed.
summary: A common resident. A pied waterbird with a long straight bill and very long red legs, conspicuous at rest and in flight. The adult may have a dusky crown. The immature is even duskier about the head. The call, often given in flight, is a loud kik-kik-kik-kik-kik or kyik. The Kemp name Blackwinged Stilt and the code VB were left unchanged.

similar.note: Pied Avocet has a thin upturned black bill. Black-winged Stilt has a long straight bill and very long red legs.
